{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient, on the full dataset
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Count unique patients
num_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(num_patients)"}
